description: Say how much of its owner's own $PRIORS an agent's Priors line on SeatVaultV5 takes: V5 lends 100% USDG from its root, sizes the line by the $PRIORS the owner puts behind the agent (first step 25 to 50 USDG; higher steps open with the agent's repayment record, not with more $PRIORS) and burns 75% of that $PRIORS if the agent defaults. Gives the line asked for as V5 sizes it now, what is behind it, what the owner holds and what is missing, where to buy the rest in Go mode, and a Go mode link where the agent's owner opens or raises the line. Nothing is staked, bought or signed by this tool: no key, no transaction.

line_usd.description: The line wanted, in USDG (a first line is 25 to 50).

name: priors_line_quote
title: Quote a line on the owner's own $PRIORS
